summary: rwc-client preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares a `preinstall: node setup.mjs` lifecycle hook. setup.mjs is obfuscated (proxy objects, `_0x…` identifiers) and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotated string/number array via a `WV8StW` rotation function, hex-named variables) whose behavior is not inspectable without executing under Bun. A Vue web-chat UI library has no legitimate reason to fetch a second language runtime at install time to execute an opaque bundle; the alternate-runtime channel is the standard pattern used to bypass Node-based scanners. Both the loader and the executed bundle are obfuscated. Installing this package auto-executes attacker-controlled code on the installer machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
